subject: Commitment recast and execution memo — Veridian capacity & pricing request
body:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@veridianhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@veridianhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Change request — add capacity + price adjustment (initial)

Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the numbers and are looking to accelerate our production deployment. Attached is the change request (Veridian_Change_Request_v3.docx) with the high level ask: add 120k throughput units (peak burst pool) and shift the fee schedule for Q4 so we can onboard earlier.

High-level asks:
- Effective date: target Nov 1, 2026 start of provisioning
- Commit: additional 120k throughput units (12-month term)
- Request a temporary implementation fee deferral: move 50% of the onboarding fee into a credit applied across the first three invoices
- Need MSA redline confirmation on section 5.2 (data retention) and SLA carve for burst pools

Can you confirm pricing and whether this is a change order vs. an amendment to the order form + MSA redline? Also include the point of contact for signatures and billing.

Emma Jones
Head of Procurement | Veridian Health
emma.jones@veridianhealth.com
Attachment: Veridian_Change_Request_v3.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Change request — add capacity + price adjustment (initial)

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the doc. We can do this as a change order to the existing Order Form combined with an MSA redline for the few carve-outs you noted.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Jordan (legal) to review and pull a redline for the MSA (data retention + SLA carve).
2) Markus (finance) to model amortized credit vs onboarding deferral and confirm P&L impact.
3) Irene (contracts) to prepare the change order/exec-ready order form for DocuSign routing once redlines are approved.

Can you confirm the signature authority for Veridian and the billing contact? Also, is November 1 a hard start or is Nov 8 acceptable if provisioning slips by a week?

I’ll loop the team — we should have an internal consensus and a draft redline by EOD tomorrow.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
(415) 555-0187

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Emma Jones <emma.jones@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:40:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Change request — add capacity + price adjustment (legal redline notes)

Emma / Hannah — quick legal read and a few open items. I’ve attached a PDF with inline redlines (redline_MSA_20261012.pdf). Summary of points: 

1) Data retention (Sec 5.2): proposed language narrows retention to event logs only for the additional burst pool, with aggregated telemetry retained for 90 days. Please confirm this aligns with Veridian’s compliance needs.

2) SLA carve for burst pools: we can provide a best-effort SLA but need an explicit fallback model when burst capacity is unavailable (automatic fallback to baseline model + credit calculation). Proposed fallback and credit calculation are in the attachment.

3) Implementation fee deferral: legal is neutral; we need finance to confirm how the credit should be structured in the order form (line item vs. credit memo).

4) Signature authority & billing contact: include full name, title, and email for whoever will sign and who will receive invoices. Also tell us whether Veridian requires countersignature hardware (DocuSign is fine on our side).

Irene — once we have confirmation on items 1–4 I’ll finalize the MSA redline and circulate for countersign.

Jordan Blake
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
Attachment: redline_MSA_20261012.pdf (application/pdf)

---
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@veridianhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@veridianhealth.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:20:55 -0700
Subject: Re: Change request — add capacity + price adjustment (legal redline notes)

Jordan / Hannah — thanks for the quick turnaround. Responses below (inline):

> Data retention (Sec 5.2): proposed language narrows retention to event logs only for the additional burst pool, with aggregated telemetry retained for 90 days. Please confirm this aligns with Veridian’s compliance needs.

Confirmed — event logs and aggregated telemetry for 90 days is acceptable. We do need confirmation that any PHI is never cached in the burst KV cache; please add an explicit statement that PHI is excluded from caching for the burst pool.

> SLA carve for burst pools: we can provide a best-effort SLA but need an explicit fallback model when burst capacity is unavailable (automatic fallback to baseline model + credit calculation). Proposed fallback and credit calculation are in the attachment.

Acceptable. Please include the fallback credit formula in the order form (so procurement can tie it to invoices).

> Implementation fee deferral: legal is neutral; we need finance to confirm how the credit should be structured in the order form (line item vs. credit memo).

Signature authority for Veridian: Emma Jones, Head of Procurement — emma.jones@veridianhealth.com (as above).
Billing contact: accounts.payable@veridianhealth.com.

DocuSign: yes, please route to emma.jones@veridianhealth.com and accounts.payable@veridianhealth.com.

We’re aiming for a Nov 1 provisioning start; Nov 8 is an acceptable contingency.

— Emma

---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 15:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Change request — add capacity + price adjustment (final next steps)

Emma — thanks, all notes captured. Short summary and action items so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary:
- Change order to add 120k throughput units, 12-month term.
- MSA redline: data retention narrowed to event logs; PHI explicitly excluded from burst KV cache.
- SLA: best-effort burst pool with fallback to baseline model + invoice credit formula included in the Order Form.
- Implementation kickoff window: target Nov 1 (fall back Nov 8).
- Implementation fee: 50% onboarding fee deferred; finance to apply as amortized credit across first three invoices.

Action items and owners:
- Jordan to finalize MSA redline and circulate by EOD Fri, Oct 16. (Jordan)
- Markus to confirm credit structuring (line item vs. credit memo) and provide final numbers by Oct 16. (Markus)
- Irene to prepare an exec-ready change order + Order Form that includes the credit line and fallback credit formula, then route via DocuSign to emma.jones@veridianhealth.com and accounts.payable@veridianhealth.com. (Irene)
- Hannah to schedule implementation kickoff (tentatively Nov 2) and share implementation checklist. (Hannah)

DocuSign link (provisional): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/ABC123-veridian
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/VER-2026-078
Attachments included: implementation_checklist_20261015.xlsx

If that captures everything, I’ll mark this ready for legal to finalize and Irene to start routing.

Best,
— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
(415) 555-0187
Attachment: implementation_checklist_20261015.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
